name: Theramore Medal
summary: A Theramore Medal is a military insignia carried by the Alliance garrison stationed at Northwatch Hold. Emblazoned with the mark of Theramore, these tokens serve as identifying proof of service among the marines and officers defending the outpost along the Merchant Coast.

sections.title: Tokens of Northwatch
sections.body: Carried by marines, marksmen, commandos, and officers serving out of Northwatch Hold, these stamped medals signify military allegiance to Lady Jaina Proudmoore's realm of Theramore. To the human soldiers perched on the cliffs overlooking the Barrens, they represent legitimate service and sovereign authority in a hostile frontier. To outsiders, however, the medals are trophies of an overzealous foreign garrison that treats every approaching vessel along the coast as a mortal threat.

sections.title: Pirate Vengeance
sections.body: Northwatch Hold's gun batteries pose a deadly hazard to maritime traffic navigating the Merchant Coast, frequently bombarding privateers and merchantmen alike. In response to lost vessels, Ratchet privateer Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun seeks these medals as proof that Northwatch's trigger-happy ranks have paid in blood for sinking his ships.

faq.answer: It is an insignia carried by Theramore military personnel deployed at Northwatch Hold. It identifies the bearer as an active marine, sailor, or officer serving the Alliance garrison in the Barrens.

aliases: where do theramore medals come from
faq.answer: They are carried by the soldiers of Northwatch Hold along the Merchant Coast, including marines, sharpshooters, deck hands, commandos, and the garrison's senior cannoneers and officers.

faq.q: Why does Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun want them?
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold's artillery batteries have been bombarding passing ships, including vessels belonging to Captain Brightsun's fleet. He demands the medals as undeniable proof that the soldiers responsible have been slain in retribution.

faq.q: Why is Northwatch Hold attacking passing ships?
faq.answer: The garrison at Northwatch operates in a state of heightened paranoia on the edge of Horde territory. Their cannoneers have grown reckless and trigger-happy, firing on nearly any vessel that approaches their coastal enclave.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, seeing medals of Theramore collected as blood bounties is a harsh reminder of how isolated and aggressive Northwatch Hold has become on Kalimdor's frontier.
Horde adventurers see these medals as physical proof of the growing Alliance military presence encroaching directly onto the shores of the Barrens.
